text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Inari One chides Yaeno 
Muteki for holding back her strength
after all. However,
Yaeno believed she had given 
it her absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki asked her Trainer whether
she 
was failing to put forth her full 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer agrees that she didn't give
it 
her all. For that is the nature of her 
running—the union of fire and water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she gives it everything she has, it 
could become her greatest weapon.
However, 
you warn her of the risk: the danger of 
being consumed by passion and running out 
of control.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing the story, Yaeno Muteki fell 
silent. Eventually, she stated that she 
would give it careful thought while 
preparing for the upcoming Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).
